note: Page County Conservation Board's North Campground at Pierce Creek Recreation Area (361 acres, a 30-acre lake, trails and public hunting), in woods off 140th St north of Essex, well away from the lake. A camping cabin can be reserved; the park's equestrian campground is a separate loop. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $15 base (primitive $6 sites have no pad), 50 A + water, 18 sites, showers, first-come. Added season Apr 15 - Nov 1. Fit: electric pads 30-70 ft. Not waterfront confirmed: the 30-acre lake is outside a 900-m frame around the loop.
flags: FIT: electric sites have gravel pads of 30-70 ft (site 18 is 30 ft, the rest 45-70 ft); a 23-ft motorhome fits.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed. The lake is 30 acres (not a pond), but NAIP shows the North Campground loop in forest off 140th St with no water within ~450 m; the note's ~0.7 km is consistent.
